caption:
🌾 Who grows the world's wheat — 1961 → 2024.

In 1961 the Soviet Union grew more wheat than anyone: 62 million tonnes. China now grows 140. Watch India's line after 1968: high-yield seeds and irrigation — the Green Revolution — take it from 11 to 113 million tonnes. And watch Russia appear in third place the moment the USSR line disappears in 1991.

📊 Data: FAOSTAT, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0). The USSR counts as a single entity until 1991.
